    small: 14,
    body: 18,
    title: 32,
  },
  radius: 12,
  canvas: {
    width: 800,
    height: 500,
  },
} as const;

/** Canvas font string, e.g. canvasFont('title') → 'bold 32px "Trebuchet MS", …'. */
export function canvasFont(size: 'small' | 'body' | 'title', weight: 'normal' | 'bold' = 'normal') {
  return `${weight} ${theme.font[size]}px ${theme.font.family}`;
}

/** Exposes the theme to CSS as custom properties, e.g. --color-accent. */
export function applyTheme(root: HTMLElement = document.documentElement) {
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(theme.colors)) {
    root.style.setProperty(`--color-${name}`, value);
  }
  root.style.setProperty('--font-family', theme.font.family);
  root.style.setProperty('--radius', `${theme.radius}px`);
}

content.text:
The carnival now has a Halloween theme. `npm run check` passes (lint, formatting, types and all 63 tests), but I haven't looked at it in a browser yet. Run `npm run dev` and open localhost:5173 to see it.

**What changed** (on a new branch, `halloween-theme`, not committed yet):
- **Theme** (`src/carnival/theme.ts`): pumpkin-orange and purple stripes on a near-black purple background, bone-white text, candle-gold accent and blood-red for danger. Every game and the page's CSS read these colours, so all three games and the booth cards switch over without any changes of their own.
- **Midway map** (`src/midway/palette.ts`): a night sky fading from midnight to dusk purple, dark clouds, fog on the horizon, dead grass, dirt paths and dark hedges. The tents are orange and purple, and the bunting is orange, black, purple and gold. Balloons and shirts now come in Halloween colours too.
- **New scenery** (`src/midway/render.ts`, `src/midway/midway.ts`): a glowing full moon and four flapping bats that drift across the sky. They stay still if someone has reduced motion turned on.
- **Browser tab icon** (`index.html`): 🎪 is now 🎃.

**Things to know:**
- The water cannon is now a ghostly teal. The game also has one hard-coded blue (`#4fc3f7`, in `src/games/water-cannon/game.ts`) that skips the theme, so that bit stays blue. I left it alone because it's a separate house-rule problem.
- The repo's rules say changes to `src/carnival/` go in their own PR. This change touches the shared theme and the midway together, so you may want to split it when you open the PR.
- My first `npm run format` ran before dependencies were installed and reformatted some files I hadn't touched. I put those back, so the diff now only has the five files above.

Want me to commit this and open a PR?

- **Theme** (`src/carnival/theme.ts`): pumpkin-orange and purple stripes, a near-black purple background, bone-white text, candle-gold accent, blood-red danger. Every game and the page CSS pick these up automatically.
- **Midway palette** (`src/midway/palette.ts`): night sky, dark clouds, foggy horizon, dead grass, dirt paths, dark hedges; orange/purple tents and Halloween bunting, balloons and shirts.
